pages.story_purpose: Establish Kaito's world, sketchbook, and quiet creative hunger
pages.action: Kaito sits at his desk finishing a half-hearted doodle, then closes the sketchbook without completing the face
pages.camera_notes: Wide of bedroom desk, then close on unfinished page
pages.caption: Kaito leaves lines unfinished. Unfinished lines cannot fail.

pages.story_purpose: Show daily ritual and visual lock on Kaito's design
pages.action: Kaito pulls on his hooded jacket, stuffs the sketchbook into his bag, glances once at the unfinished page
pages.camera_notes: Full-body getting ready; detail of bag zip; doorway exit

pages.story_purpose: Introduce neighbourhood as safe ordinary world
pages.action: Kaito walks familiar streets, sketchbook corner sticking from bag; he notices a poster for the school art festival
pages.camera_notes: Street establishing shot; medium on Kaito reading poster
dialogue: Art festival... maybe I'll skip entering.

pages.story_purpose: Introduce Ren and friendship dynamic
pages.action: Ren jogs up, steals a peek at the sketchbook, teases Kaito about never finishing pieces
pages.camera_notes: Two-shot at school gate; close on Ren's grin; Kaito shielding sketchbook
dialogue: Then finish one and prove me wrong.

pages.story_purpose: Show imagination overflowing into margins
pages.action: During class, Kaito doodles a fox in the notebook margin; the bell rings before he finishes the tail
pages.camera_notes: Over-shoulder on notebook; soft focus classroom behind
pages.caption: Some ideas wait patiently. Others wait less patiently.

pages.story_purpose: Plant quest energy; Ren proposes exploring for art supplies
pages.action: Ren suggests checking a side street for a stationery shop rumored to have 'weird old ink'
pages.camera_notes: School hallway medium; exit toward street
dialogue: Come on. One weird shop. For the festival.
I don't even know if I'm entering.

pages.story_purpose: Transition toward the mysterious shop
pages.action: They turn down a narrow street Kaito somehow never noticed; a small shop sign hangs ahead
pages.camera_notes: Street canyon perspective leading to shop

pages.story_purpose: Chapter button; introduce shop as otherworldly ordinary
pages.action: Kaito pauses at the doorway; bell chime; shelves of paper and bottles; Ren pushes him gently inside
pages.camera_notes: Exterior doorway; hand on door; first interior glimpse
dialogue: It smells like rain and paper.
That's either magic or mold. Let's go.
pages.caption: Chapter 1 — end

pages.story_purpose: Introduce Mira and the shop's careful rules atmosphere
pages.action: Mira appears behind the counter, studying Kaito more than Ren; she asks what he is looking for
pages.camera_notes: Counter two-shot; close on Mira's calm eyes; Kaito fidgeting
dialogue: Most things here work. Few things forgive.

pages.story_purpose: Build mystery; Ren distracts while Kaito is drawn to one shelf
pages.action: Ren examines novelty pens; Kaito's attention locks on a high shelf with a covered object
pages.camera_notes: Split focus: Ren silly, Kaito serious toward shelf

pages.story_purpose: First clear look at THE INKWELL as object of power
pages.action: Mira lifts the cloth; the Inkwell sits dark and quiet, faintly reflecting Kaito's face in the glass
pages.camera_notes: Cloth pull; hero object shot of Inkwell

pages.story_purpose: State core Inkwell rules for young readers
pages.action: Mira lists three rules: finish what you start, own what appears, ink is not endless
pages.camera_notes: Panel per rule, Mira as steady anchor
dialogue: And never pretend the ink is endless.

pages.story_purpose: Kaito accepts responsibility by choosing the Inkwell
pages.action: Ren jokes about magic markers; Kaito quietly asks if he may borrow the Inkwell; Mira agrees under conditions
pages.camera_notes: Comic beat with Ren; quiet beat with Kaito; Mira handing Inkwell

pages.story_purpose: Carry object into ordinary world; secrecy seed
pages.action: Kaito cradles the Inkwell wrapped in cloth; Ren asks what Mira meant; Kaito says he isn't sure yet
pages.camera_notes: Street walk; close on wrapped Inkwell in arms

pages.story_purpose: Prepare first ritual of use
pages.action: Night. Kaito clears desk, places Inkwell beside sketchbook, opens lid carefully
pages.camera_notes: Night window; desk ritual; lid opening detail

pages.story_purpose: Chapter button; first contact with magical ink
pages.action: Kaito dips a brush; ink gleams; he begins redrawing the unfinished fox with care
pages.camera_notes: Brush tip in ink; first confident stroke on paper
pages.caption: Chapter 2 — end. The page listens.

pages.story_purpose: Show intentional finishing as the key
pages.action: Kaito draws the final stroke of the fox's tail and writes a small name: Sumi
pages.camera_notes: Hand finishing stroke; full finished drawing on page

pages.story_purpose: Magic payoff; Echo enters reality
pages.action: Lines shimmer; Sumi the ink-fox steps off the page onto the desk, ink-whiskers twitching
pages.camera_notes: Shimmer effect; paw leaving page; Kaito wide-eyed reaction

pages.story_purpose: Bond forming; creation has personality and limits
pages.action: Sumi nuzzles Kaito's hand, then fades slightly when Kaito looks away in panic; focus restores solidity
pages.emotion: delight with first hint of rules
pages.camera_notes: Cute close-up; partial fade; restored form
pages.caption: Attention is part of the ink.

pages.story_purpose: Normalize wonder; show Sumi can rest on the page
pages.action: Morning light; Sumi curls back onto the sketchbook outline to sleep as a drawing until called
pages.camera_notes: Soft morning; fox becoming flat ink on paper

pages.story_purpose: Secret pressure; Ren notices change in Kaito
pages.action: At school Kaito seems happier; Ren asks what happened; Kaito dodges but promises to show him soon
pages.camera_notes: Classroom desk conversation

pages.story_purpose: Reveal pocket drawing-space accessed via Inkwell focus
pages.action: After school, focused drawing opens a soft paper-world where Kaito and Sumi run across ink hills
pages.camera_notes: Wide fantastical landscape; joyful running shot

pages.story_purpose: Foreshadow limits; no unlimited power
pages.action: The hills begin to wash pale; Sumi points toward the fading horizon; Kaito feels a headache
pages.camera_notes: Color/ink wash-out; Sumi alarmed; Kaito clutching head

pages.story_purpose: Chapter button; close Inkwell responsibly for now
pages.action: Kaito closes the Inkwell lid; drawing-space collapses safely; Sumi returns to page; Kaito breathes hard
pages.camera_notes: Lid closing; world fold; exhausted smile
pages.caption: Chapter 3 — end

pages.story_purpose: External pressure that tempts misuse
pages.action: Teacher announces festival deadline; Ren signs Kaito up without asking; classmates look over
pages.camera_notes: Announcement board; Ren's mischievous signing; Kaito mortified

pages.story_purpose: Create the unfinished antagonist through emotion
pages.action: Night. Panicked, Kaito sketches a big guardian to 'protect' him from judgment; lines are jagged; he stops mid-form
pages.camera_notes: Harsh night lighting; jagged strokes; abandoned page
dialogue: If I make something strong enough...

pages.story_purpose: Show unfinished + emotion = unstable Echo
pages.action: Ink drips upward from the page; a shadow-shape flickers in the corner of the room
pages.camera_notes: Impossible drip; corner silhouette

pages.story_purpose: Bad solution; erasure without facing emotion fails
pages.action: Kaito tries to scribble out the drawing; the scribble only makes the shadow thrash and flee through the window as ink mist
pages.camera_notes: Scribble chaos; window escape; empty room aftermath

pages.story_purpose: Consequences enter public space
pages.action: Morning. Strange ink scuffs mark fences and walls along Kaito's route; neighbours murmur
pages.camera_notes: Street with ink marks; Kaito following trail

pages.story_purpose: Midpoint setup: friendship meets secret
pages.action: Ren finds Kaito calling Sumi out to track the marks; Sumi appears; Ren freezes, then believes
pages.camera_notes: Reveal of Sumi; Ren reaction; pact beat

pages.story_purpose: Midpoint turn — threat is real and visible
pages.action: At the far end of the street, The Unfinished rises as a large ink-silhouette with incomplete edges, then vanishes into an alley
pages.camera_notes: Dramatic wide silhouette; characters small in frame
pages.caption: Midpoint

pages.story_purpose: Seek guidance; Mira refuses to solve it for him
pages.action: Mira listens; she says only the creator can finish or transform an Echo born of their fear
pages.camera_notes: Shop counter counsel; Mira firm; Ren supportive
dialogue: I can teach. I cannot finish your line.

pages.story_purpose: Clarify solution path for climax
pages.action: Mira explains: enter the drawing-space with the original page, face the Unfinished, complete it with honest intent—not fear
pages.camera_notes: Instructional calm panels
dialogue: Finish it as what it was meant to be—protection, not panic.

pages.story_purpose: Chapter button; resource crisis
pages.action: They check the Inkwell; only a shallow pool remains; one careful attempt left
pages.camera_notes: Close on nearly empty Inkwell; trio faces
pages.caption: Chapter 4 — end

pages.story_purpose: Crisis — Unfinished threatens Ren
pages.action: Near the school fence after hours, The Unfinished lunges as ink-tendrils; Ren is knocked down; Sumi shields him
pages.camera_notes: Action panels; keep readable for coloring; clear silhouettes

pages.story_purpose: Kaito stops running from the unfinished page
pages.action: Kaito pulls out the jagged drawing, hands shaking, and tells Ren to hold the Inkwell steady
pages.camera_notes: Close on shaking hands; Ren bracing Inkwell

pages.story_purpose: Cross into stormy drawing-space for climax approach
pages.action: The world becomes a storm of unfinished strokes; hills are scribbled; sky is blank paper tearing
pages.camera_notes: Establishing chaotic paper-world

pages.story_purpose: Antagonist confrontation; reveal need
pages.action: The Unfinished looms, incomplete mouth forming words of hunger: complete me / don't leave me
pages.camera_notes: Low angle on creature; Kaito standing ground; Sumi beside him

pages.story_purpose: Show force/erasure still fails; reinforce theme
pages.action: Kaito tries a heavy blacking-out stroke; the world quakes worse; Ren shouts to draw what he means
pages.camera_notes: Failed stroke shockwave; Ren grab; reset stance

pages.story_purpose: Turn of craft and heart; begin true finishing
pages.action: Kaito redraws the silhouette into a guardian with open posture, soft edges, and a clear face—protection without threat
pages.camera_notes: Process panels of transforming lines
dialogue: You were meant to guard—not scare.

pages.story_purpose: Cost beat; friends lend focus as ink runs out
pages.action: Brush scrapes dry; Ren and Sumi place hands on Kaito's shoulders; their presence steadies the final line
continuity_for_next: friendship as support not magic cheat
pages.camera_notes: Dry brush; hands on shoulders; trio silhouette

pages.story_purpose: Chapter button; Unfinished becomes complete Echo
pages.action: Final stroke closes the form; The Unfinished settles into a calm ink-guardian; storm softens to clear paper sky
pages.camera_notes: Transformation glow as line-art shimmer; peaceful wide
pages.caption: Chapter 5 — end

pages.story_purpose: Show real-world consequences healing
pages.action: They tumble back to the alley; ink scuffs fade to faint watermarks; evening feels ordinary again
pages.camera_notes: Alley exit; fading marks montage

pages.story_purpose: Creator-creation relationship resolved with care
pages.action: On the page, the guardian sleeps as a finished drawing beside Sumi; Kaito thanks them both
continuity_for_next: both creations at peace on page
pages.camera_notes: Sketchbook spread with two finished beings
dialogue: Thank you for waiting for me.

pages.story_purpose: Accountability with Mira; Inkwell not discarded lightly
pages.action: Kaito offers the Inkwell back; Mira says he may keep it if he keeps the rules—ink will refill slowly with care, never endlessly
pages.camera_notes: Offering Inkwell; Mira's nod; returned/kept beat
dialogue: Then it may stay with you—while you stay with your lines.

pages.story_purpose: Self-belief payoff without cheating via magic spectacle
pages.action: Kaito draws a festival piece the ordinary way—Sumi and a gentle guardian—using normal ink for the display copy
pages.camera_notes: Desk work montage; finished poster art
dialogue: This one I finish for me.

pages.story_purpose: Public courage; friendship celebrated
pages.action: At the festival board, classmates praise the piece; Ren elbows Kaito proudly; Kaito accepts the compliments
pages.camera_notes: Festival hall; art on wall; friends reacting

pages.story_purpose: Thematic landing; ordinary world cherished
pages.action: Friends walk home under streetlights; Ren asks if magic is over; Kaito says the important part isn't
pages.camera_notes: Soft street night; two-shot walking
dialogue: Only when I choose it carefully.

pages.story_purpose: Sequel hook without breaking resolution
pages.action: Alone in the shop, Mira shelves a second cloth-covered tool that faintly trembles; she smiles knowingly
pages.camera_notes: Shop night interior; covered object detail

pages.story_purpose: Resolution button; creator at peace with tools and self
pages.action: Kaito sleeps at desk; Sumi curls as ink on the open page; Inkwell closed nearby; unfinished page nowhere in sight—only finished work
pages.camera_notes: Single full-page peaceful composition for coloring
pages.caption: End of Volume 1 — Echo of the Inkwell
